description: Task lifecycle commands, sub-agent context manifest gate, reversible ablation, OpenCode mem reader restored, and hook/channel fixes
changelog:
**Enhancements:**
- task.py: rename command, branch metadata recorded at start and validated at archive, jsonl manifests seeded empty (#578)
- Context manifest gate: task.py validate fails and start refuses seed-only implement.jsonl / check.jsonl; bypass with --allow-empty-context (#573)
- trellis ablate / trellis restore: reversible removal of all Trellis-managed files (#538)
- add_session.py is a resumable state machine; failed runs resume instead of leaving partial records (#577)
- trellis mem: OpenCode session reader restored without a native dependency (#574)
- OMP honors prompt_injection.skip_keyword (#586)

**Bug Fixes:**
- Auto-commits in add_session.py and task.py archive use explicit pathspecs; pre-staged unrelated files stay untouched (#579)
- Path containment accepts a .trellis symlinked into an external store (#567)
- Task script runtime hardening: git index.lock retry, JSON read diagnostics (#576)
- trellis update repairs receipt entries for files already identical to their template (#575)
- Pi resolves the Trellis project root from the session cwd (#581)
- Sub-agent context hook contains jsonl-referenced reads to the task base path (#584) and surfaces unreadable active-task records (#544)
- Channel: UTF-8 across incremental reads (#569), seq after a torn events.jsonl tail (#564), stdout drained before supervisor exit (#542), Claude system prompt passed as a file (#555)
- OMP: task context injection byte-budgeted, refreshed after file changes (#541), deduplicated (#540)
- OpenCode: context injected via messages.transform so TUI/history stay clean (#563)
notes: task.py validate/start now fail on seed-only implement.jsonl / check.jsonl (pass --allow-empty-context to bypass). No file migrations required.
